messages:
Nina: quick heads-up, launched a 0.75% canary for model v4.0-quant (group-int4) on rwd-nlg-chat this morning. Latency/cost look stellar but we see a localized drop in 'api-doc' and 'qa-short' slices. attaching summary.

Marta: can you paste the slice table?

Nina: sure — from 2.5k sample: 
```
slice | baseline_rougeL | v4q_rougeL | delta_pct
api-doc | 0.66 | 0.61 | -7.6%
qa-short | 0.71 | 0.66 | -6.9%
conversational | 0.78 | 0.76 | -2.6%
summaries | 0.75 | 0.74 | -1.3%
```

Ciara: that's larger than expected for those slices. any sign it's hallucination vs truncation?

Nina: automated diffs show more wrong entity substitutions and occasional numeric drift in api-doc snippets. hallucination_rate per 1k rose from 8 -> 22. Not pure truncation.

Dong: which quant path and runtime flags? groupwise int4 or per-channel? seed?

Nina: groupwise int4, asymmetric zero-point, our ff-kernel v2. config: 
```
quantization: group_int4
group_size: 64
zero_point: asymmetric
outlier_clip: top0.2%
seed: 1337
```

Marta: rollout gate proposal: hold at 0.75% until targeted human review on top-300 failing api-doc samples. For auto-fallback: trigger if any critical slice has rougeL drop >4.0% OR hallucination_inc >10 per1k, with min_samples 1800 and window 1h.

Ciara: add debouncing so a single noisy window doesn't flip. min_samples=1800 + stable_windows=2 (1h each). Also prefer composite score where hallucination is weighted 3x.

Dong: add exact_match and user_feedback as tertiary signals. will reproduce locally with seed=1337.

Nina: action items: I'll queue the 10k targeted api-doc sweep and surface top-300 for human review; Dong -> replicate quant locally and run exact_match + halluc scripts; Ciara -> update gate engine with min_samples and stable_windows; Marta -> keep canary at 0.75%.

ops-bot: Canary digest (v4.0-quant) — traffic 0.75% for 2.3h, samples=2500, p50 latency -14%, p95 -20%, token-cost -35%, fallback_state=not_triggered.

Marta: thanks. If human review reveals <=1% critical factual errors on the top-300 and composite_score <0.2 we'll consider bumping to 5%. Otherwise we iterate on quant/clamp.

Ciara: small note — for the composite score prototype I'll normalize rouge drop, hallucination_per1k, and user_reject with these weights: [0.3, 0.6, 0.1]. will post numbers tomorrow.

Nina: thanks all, tagging this as canonical canary thread. will post eval link when sweep finishes: https://internal/redwood/evals/v4.0-quant/api-doc-sweep
